Ho_He_allelic_richness.definition: complete-call biallelic autosomal SNPs from the existing normalized comparative basis

basis.allelic_richness: Analytical hypergeometric rarefaction without Monte Carlo sampling; baseline n=5, leave-one-museum cases n=4.
basis.exact_relabeling: Each basis is frozen to sites called in all 11 birds before any of the 462 label allocations; labels never alter site inclusion.

pi.definition: sum of unbiased pairwise-difference contributions at complete-call biallelic SNPs divided by all raw-VCF contig-length base pairs

bootstrap: 999 seeded 5-Mb blocks, resampled with replacement within chromosome; terminal blocks retain their recorded opportunity length.
caveats: Museum and modern birds are geographically mismatched; no outcome can isolate time from geography.
Ancient-DNA damage reduction by transversion filtering does not remove all museum-specific technical bias.
Genomic diversity differences are associations in deposited samples, not fitness effects or causal temporal erosion.
exact_permutation: All C(11,5)=462 label allocations; genotype patterns are base-3 aggregated and evaluated in bounded matrix batches.

numeric_falsifier.claim_upgrade_condition: The directional condition must pass and the museum-modern geographic mismatch must be resolved by the study design.
numeric_falsifier.directional_condition: All 4 metrics must remain museum-higher after every predeclared all-SNP/transversion, six equal-n, and 11 leave-one stress test.

question: Does the weak museum-higher diversity direction survive damage-aware and individual-influence stress tests?

variant_handling.all_snp: transition plus transversion biallelic single-base SNPs
variant_handling.other_records: MNV, indel, multiallelic, and symbolic/other records are reconciled in the classification table and excluded from SNP metrics.
variant_handling.transversion_only: biallelic single-base SNPs excluding C<->T and G<->A transitions
